All 12-month, no annualization needed (base year is normal 12m, unlike 325A). Revenue/OP/COGS/SGA/NetIncome/DA/Capex from Tanshin PL & CF. _hist_revenue_note: FY2022/10=16,144, FY2023/10=26,880, FY2024/10=34,289 (these are the 3 disclosed annual figures). FY2025/10: tanshin shows 34,289 as latest full consolidated 12m. _comment_base_year: Base year = FY2025/10 (34,289), a NORMAL 12-month period — no annualization needed (contrast 325A's 7-month annualization). COGS 1,912 (COGS% 5.6%, platform near-zero cost of revenue). OP 6,747 (OP margin 19.7%). Gross margin ~94%.
_comment_nwc: NWC from FY2025/10 / 1H FY2026 interim BS. AR=売掛金 3,859. INV=0 (matching platform holds NO inventory — key structural contrast vs 325A's 4,861 inventory). AP=未払金 2,656. dih_days=0 throughout.
_comment_scenarios: Base = company guidance (CAGR ~20% revenue, 'FY2026 is investment/仕込み phase' tapering). Upside = scale leverage on SGA + new verticals (logistics/care) succeed, re-acceleration. Management = company mid-term plan (revenue CAGR20%, profit CAGR30%, margin improves). Downside1 = competition (Mercari Hello, LINE Skima, Recruit) slows growth. Downside2 = investment phase fails to convert, SGA pressure persists. COGS% ~5.5-6.0% (platform). SGA% is the swing factor. dih_days=0 (NO inventory).
_comment_capex_da: Asset-light platform. DA% ~0.5% (FY2024/10: 153/34,289=0.45%), Capex% ~1.0% of revenue. No inventory burden (contrast 325A). revenue_pct method.
_comment_tax: Statutory ~30-31%. Solidly profitable, effective near statutory.
_comment_wacc: risk_free 1.2%, ERP 6.0%, size_premium 3.0% (smaller than 325A's 4.0% as Timee has larger absolute profit). Beta 1.5 cap (yfinance live may override; range guard [0.6,1.5] in template, live fell back to 1.0). Cost of equity = 1.2 + 1.5*6.0 + 3.0 = 13.2% (or with beta 1.0: 10.2%).
_comment_debt: Net cash. Interest-bearing debt ~14,225 (short-term borrowings 13,500 + 1yr-long 140 + long-term 585) at 1H FY2026, but cash ~16,540 => net cash. Actually short-term borrowings are large (working-capital facility for 立替金/advances to workers). Using net_debt = -2,300 (conservative net cash). de_ratio small. NOT EDINET-derived (manual, avoid narrow-taxonomy trap).
_comment_terminal: Terminal growth 1.5%. Exit EV/EBITDA 12x (platform/high-growth, user-selected). Timee solidly profitable so EV/EBITDA meaningful. Cross-check EV/Sales with growth-normalization given comps span (Visional/SMS/CrowdWorks/Wantedly differ widely in growth & margin).
_comment_v3: Primary multiple = EV/EBITDA (Timee OP margin ~20%, EBITDA stable). Cross-check EV/Sales÷growth against HR/matching comps (growth-normalization essential; comps span Visional mid-growth to Wantedly flat).
investment_thesis: 1. Category-leading spot-work platform: Timee is Japan's No.1 spot-work matching platform with first-mover network effects (workers x businesses two-sided liquidity)
2. High-margin platform economics: gross margin ~92%, OP margin ~20%, strong operating leverage; FY2025/10 revenue 34,289mn (+27.6%), first full consolidated year
3. Growth runway: new verticals (logistics, nursing-care/福祉) and SkimaWorks-type M&A expand TAM; structural labor-shortage tailwind in Japan
key_risks: 1. Competition intensifying: Mercari Hello, LINE Skima-niwa, Recruit/Indeed entering spot-work; two-sided network advantage could erode
2. Investment phase: company guides FY2026 as a 'shikomi (仕込み)' investment phase with intentional strategic spend, temporarily suppressing profit growth
3. Fiscal-period change (Oct-end → Apr-end, 12m→6m irregular) makes short-term YoY comparison opaque; large short-term borrowings fund worker advances (立替金)
